help.goal: Goal: capture the capitals of all enemies.
help.pickEmpire: At the start, you can click any capital to play as that empire (until you make your first move).
help.moves: You have 5 moves per turn; each army can move once.
help.clickArmy: Click your army, then a highlighted adjacent tile.
help.merge: Moving onto a tile with your own army merges them (max 99, same type only).
help.unitTypes: 3 unit types: infantry (balanced), tanks (strong attack and mobility, weaker defense) and artillery (strong defense and support, weak attack, slow).
help.buildChoice: Click your own city to choose which unit type it builds.
help.production: Cities produce +1 strength per turn, the capital +3.
help.resources: Resources (oil well, farmland, mine) give +1 production once you build a road to them from a city's production panel (costs production points instead of units, only through your own territory). Roads between cities speed up army movement.
help.morale: Morale drops with distance from your nearest city and at sea — it affects combat strength.
help.support: Adjacent friendly armies give support in battle; a city strengthens the defender.
help.ports: From a port (⚓), an army can sail out to sea and land on any shore.
help.annex: Capturing an enemy capital annexes their entire empire.
